# Founder peer groups

> Independent, factual comparison site for founder and CEO peer groups.
> Costs, requirements, and stage fit from verified public sources.
> Prices are never estimated. Every claim traces to the dataset with sources.

Site: https://founderpeergroups.com/
Maintainer disclosure: https://founderpeergroups.com/methodology/

## Key pages

- Methodology (sourcing, ranking rules, FounderNexus disclosure): https://founderpeergroups.com/methodology/
- Full dataset (sortable table + CSV): https://founderpeergroups.com/data/
- CSV download: https://founderpeergroups.com/groups.csv

## Best for stage

- Pre-seed and seed: https://founderpeergroups.com/best/pre-seed-seed/
- Series A: https://founderpeergroups.com/best/series-a/
- Growth: https://founderpeergroups.com/best/growth/
- Late stage: https://founderpeergroups.com/best/late-stage/

## Best for situation

- First-time founder: https://founderpeergroups.com/best/first-time-founder/
- Solo founder: https://founderpeergroups.com/best/solo-founder/
- Just raised: https://founderpeergroups.com/best/just-raised/
- Considering an exit: https://founderpeergroups.com/best/considering-exit/
- Venture-backed: https://founderpeergroups.com/best/venture-backed/
- Women founders and leaders: https://founderpeergroups.com/best/women-founders-leaders/

## Other page types

- Group profiles: https://founderpeergroups.com/groups/{slug}/
- Pairwise compare: https://founderpeergroups.com/compare/{a}-vs-{b}/
- Alternatives: https://founderpeergroups.com/alternatives/{slug}/

## Data quality

Fields come from each group's own site or official documents linked as sources.
`last_verified` dates appear on content pages. Target re-verification every 30 days.
